cause: Fresh Native profiles can have a ready owned Host without the legacy principal store. Existing callCore resolves principalFor before status.health and returns PRINCIPAL_STORE_ABSENT without dispatching GET /healthz. This must be fixed at the bridge, without weakening UI health validation or fabricating a principal file.
patch: Keep the existing ensureCore/discovery checks as the first boundary.

Only the exact pair client==='status' && method==='health' gets a principal-independent fixed request: verb GET, relative path /healthz, empty payload and headers. Untrusted caller fields cannot select origin, URL, path, verb, headers, identity, executable, or proxy.

Validate/reject nonempty or malformed health request bodies so the public operation remains an empty observation. Confirm existing request representation and error naming from current source before implementation.
Every other pair follows the unchanged principalFor and requestFor path, including other status reads and all workspace/session/provider mutations.
Use the existing response error handling; do not turn unavailable/malformed health into a synthetic ready result. UI still requires exact ok/status/scope/database values.
No changes to preload, UI8, contracts, user data, principal/auth files or runtime state. No legacy principal file creation.
regressions: Actual callCore with missing legacy principal, fake owned discovery and fake transport sends exactly one GET /healthz with fixed empty request; returned ready shape is preserved.
Health unavailable/error/malformed payload does not become ready; existing strict UI classifier source stays unchanged.
No discovery/unready Host returns the original ensureCore failure and sends nothing.
status.host, workspace read/write, session operations and provider configure/probe with missing principal retain original identity failure and zero transport calls.
Existing authenticated non-health requests preserve method/path/payload/principal headers and provider classification.
Caller path/url/verb/header/principal body fields cannot influence the health request or reach transport; reject nonempty, array and scalar bodies.
Narrow existing pure compatibility and syntax/Git range checks only; no Electron, real HTTP listener, Native, model, credentials or user DB.
